page.layout: One page of text, one column of running text; a running head at the top centre. No marginal notes. Digitiser's watermark at bottom right is left out.

main_text.p: Ecclesiæ, quod extra notionem Ecclesiæ, cum fideles in unum locum coeunt ad audiendum & prædicandum verbum; ad danda & participanda Sacramenta, & vacandum precibus, cujus Ecclesiæ solus Christus est caput & Episcopus, omnis cœtus Pastorum, Episcoporum, seniorum, Theologorum, congregatorum ad ordinandas res Ecclesiæ, sit perinde cœtus Politicus, atque cœtus mercatorum, fabrorum, Medicorum, res suas dispungentium communi jure, cujus legibus, constitutionibus, decretis, censuris, vis non accedit ab earum bonitate, æquitate, justitia, sed à voluntate decernentium & majori numero; quorum hominum in cœtum aut Synodum coactorum, tum legum, constitutionum, censurarum

page.notes: The running head is printed in italic at the top centre. The first line is printed as a continuation of the text, the page has no page number. Two marginal dots and stray specks in the scan are not text. Some letters in the lower lines are slightly blurred (e.g. "cœtum", "censurarum") but read clearly.
